t: You're in Trafalgar Square, looking at the fourth plinth. From 2020 to 2022 it held The End, by British artist Heather Phillipson. It was a gigantic dollop of melting whipped cream, topped with a cherry, with a fly and a working drone climbing its surface. The drone carried a camera that sent a live feed of the surrounding area to a website. At 9.4 metres, or 31 feet, it was the tallest work so far in the Mayor of London's Fourth Plinth Programme. Phillipson was nominated for the Turner Prize in 2022.
